_what: P6 routability probe (route_auto --probe, real Freerouting) on the DELIVERED 50.000 x 26.420 mm board.

with_planes_delivered_board._setup: copy of the delivered board -> planes_gen --constraints kicad/constraints.json -> route_auto --probe
with_planes_delivered_board._note: this is the number that grades the placement: 1.00 completion, 0 unrouted, against the >= 0.98 bar

_why_planes_first: constraints marks +3V3 and GND plane_fed - their trunk IS the F.Cu pour / B.Cu plane. Probed WITHOUT zones the same placement reads 0.89 (1 of 9 unrouted) because the router is forced to run both planes as traces on a bare 2-layer board. Probe this board class only after planes_gen, or the number grades the wrong problem.
